details.injected_rule: When declaring module interfaces and metrics, ensure that dependencies and data flows strictly follow the execution order (experiment writes results.csv before figures reads it) and avoid declaring imports between modules that are logically independent or temporally ordered, because false coupling breaks the modular contract and hinders verification.

A deliberate change of an interface needs 'contract_change': {'reason': '<why>'}; a name other modules use cannot be removed.
